description: Portrait of O'Keeffe sitting in a chair in a wheelbarrow, modeling for Mary Callery at a room in Ghost Ranch. Callery is standing and sculpting the head of O'Keeffe on a tripod sculpting stand. Callery wears a denim shirt and jeans and O'Keeffe is wearing a shawl and long skirt; viga beams, adobe walls, ladders.
title: Georgia O'Keeffe and Head by Mary Callery, Ghost Ranch, New Mexico
